requirements.statement: Implement canonical keel.mission/v2 identity, required mission/node fields, deterministic UTF-8 JSON serialization, stable ordering, POSIX repository paths, and provenance-bearing uncertainty without identity-bearing local values.
requirements.source: P2 mission schema and planning contract

requirements.statement: Validate typed dependency graphs, invalid scopes, malformed acceptance, resource conflicts, unsupported capabilities, and blocked dependencies with exact classifications.
Represent effects and authorization separately, reject unknown/missing/excess effects, and never treat declarations as permission or execute planning inputs.
Produce deterministic decomposition with bounded child scope, inherited forbidden effects and uncertainty, narrowed acceptance/authorization, and exact escape/overreach blockers.

Normalize v1 missions deterministically while preserving v1 meaning, attaching source schema/digest/provenance, marking absent v2 information unknown or documented defaults, and never claiming runtime readiness or execution.

Separate dependency, capability, authorization, runtime, and executable frontier fields; runtime-required/unobserved and P1 conflict/unsupported states remain non-executable; repeated canonical serialization is byte-identical.
requirements.source: P2 advisory frontier and uncertainty contract

requirements.statement: Keep P2 read-only and planning-only: do not dispatch workers, invoke providers, create worktrees, acquire locks, execute changes, authorize effects, seal, merge, or perform external effects; preserve mission_graph v1 behavior.
